one_line: Early Indian nationalist leader, educator and orator who helped build institutional politics and print-based nationalism.

appearance.age_look: Mid-40s, medium height, slightly slender with a scholar’s bearing and upright posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with a neat, trimmed black mustache, medium brown complexion, sharp nose, high cheekbones and thoughtful, determined eyes; default expression is calm and composed with a hint of earnest intensity, like he’s about to speak.
appearance.hair: Short, neatly combed black hair parted slightly to one side, kept close to the head; he wears a plain white Bengal-style turban (pugree) wrapped snugly, with a subtle narrow band of pale gold along the edge.
appearance.costume: A late-19th-century Calcutta bhadralok outfit: long, knee-length white cotton kurta with a simple round collar and side slits; over it a slightly off-white, finely woven Bengal dhoti with narrow pleats in front, bordered by a thin pale-gold stripe; draped over one shoulder is a soft, light-cream shawl (chadar) with a subtle woven pattern near the ends; on his feet, simple dark-brown leather closed sandals; he sometimes has a modest dark-navy woolen Western-style coat folded over one forearm (not worn, just carried) to hint at his public-lecture persona.
appearance.signature: A rolled newspaper or printed pamphlet held firmly in his right hand, edges slightly worn, symbolizing vernacular print and political communication.

ref_desc: Surendranath Banerjee is a mid-40s medium-brown man with an oval face, neat black mustache, short-parted black hair under a white Bengal turban, wearing a white kurta, off-white gold-bordered dhoti, cream shawl, carrying a dark-navy coat and a rolled newspaper in a white-cream-pale-gold-dark-navy palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Surendranath Banerjee: a mid-40s, medium-height Indian man with medium-brown skin, an oval face, sharp nose, neat trimmed black mustache and thoughtful, determined eyes, his short black hair parted slightly and covered by a plain white Bengal-style turban edged with a narrow pale-gold band. He wears a late-19th-century bhadralok outfit: a knee-length white cotton kurta with a simple round collar and side slits, over an off-white finely pleated Bengal dhoti with a thin pale-gold border along the hem, and a light-cream shawl (chadar) with subtle woven pattern draped over one shoulder. Show simple dark-brown leather closed sandals on his feet, and a modest dark-navy woolen Western-style coat folded neatly over his left forearm, while his right hand firmly grips a slightly worn rolled newspaper or pamphlet as his signature prop. Use a restrained white, cream, pale-gold, dark-navy and dark-brown color palette, and present him in a calm, composed stance with a hint of earnest intensity, suitable for consistent redrawing from multiple angles.
